prompt: In a vibrant anime style scene set within a bustling airport terminal gate, the atmosphere hums with anticipation. On the far left, a woman in a yellow raincoat stands tall, holding a crumpled boarding pass tightly in her right hand. Next to her sits a small brown dog wearing a blue bandana, its tongue lolling out happily as it looks up at her. In the center foreground, a man in a red scarf leans against a silver luggage cart, his eyes fixed on the large departure screen above. Beside him, a child in a striped shirt points excitedly at a passing airplane visible through the glass wall. To the right of the child, an elderly man in a tweed cap sits on a row of connected plastic chairs, reading a thick paperback book with intense focus. A flight attendant in a navy uniform walks past them, handing a complimentary water bottle to a teenager in a hoodie who is slumped over a backpack. Behind this group, a businessman in a grey suit checks his wristwatch anxiously while standing next to a rolling suitcase with a broken wheel. Further back near the ticket counter, a couple shares a quiet moment; the person in the denim jacket rests their head on the shoulder of the person in the floral dress. A security guard in a black vest stands firmly by the entrance, observing the crowd with a stern expression. Near the window, a tourist in a wide-brimmed hat takes a photo of the tarmac with a bulky camera. A stray cat with orange fur sleeps peacefully under an empty seat in the middle row. A janitor pushes a cleaning cart slowly across the polished floor in the background. There is no snow visible outside the windows despite the winter clothing. There is no food being served at any of the nearby kiosks.
